item.title: Inflation accelerated last month, highlighting affordability issues before election
item.description: An inflation gauge closely monitored by the Federal Reserve accelerated last month, a sign prices remain elevated less than a week from midterm elections that have focused on affordability concerns.

item.title: Pakistani rights lawyer and husband sentenced to 10 years each in cricket security breach case
item.description: A Pakistani court has sentenced a prominent human rights lawyer and her husband to 10 years in prison each for breaching security arrangements for England’s cricket team during its 2024 visit.

item.title: DoorDash to buy Instacart for $17 billion in big consolidation for grocery delivery
item.description: DoorDash is gobbling up Instacart in a $17 billion acquisition that will supercharge its grocery delivery business.

item.title: Alaska's governor orders a probe into Peltola's Senate campaign over spoiler candidate controversy
item.description: Republican Alaska Gov. Mike Dunleavy has ordered an investigation into Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Mary Peltola's campaign.

item.title: China elevates a military general to the Politburo and seeks to strengthen party discipline
item.description: China's top leaders have elevated the only remaining general of the body that oversees the country's military to its Politburo, the Communist Party's top governing body.
